report:
M1 spec-replay complete. All acceptance criteria verified.

1. **Replay measured** — 30 agent + 12 mem0 requests, 3 settings (off, A=default ngram-mod, B=short ngram-mod), 4 phases (single-agent, single-mem, dual-agent, dual-mem), on private :8089. Results at `bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/replay/` with requests.jsonl, vram.txt, and 4 server logs per config.

2. **Decision: Do not deploy.** Both slots busy → A dual-agent 26.7 vs off 31.3 tok/s; A dual-mem 23.4 vs off 25.4 tok/s (prod). Greedy: A dual-agent 25.5 vs off 26.3, B 23.0; dual-mem 23.8 vs off 25.0. Spec changes outputs (greedy 4/30 agent, 10/12 mem; dual-agent 0/30 agent). Decision documented in `bench/m1-notes.md §9d`, `site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md`, `site/series/serving/index.md`, and `site/index.md`.

3. **Site**: experiment page `site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md` created; series and project summaries updated; site checker 10 pages, 0 errors.
summary:
**Done when 1** — Replay of real agent turns (30) and mem0-style extraction (12) measured on :8089, spec off vs 2 ngram settings (A=default ngram-mod, B=short ngram-mod), 1 and 2 slots busy. Decode tok/s, draft acceptance, and temperature-0 output identity all reported in `bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/replay/{off-greedy,A-greedy,B-greedy,off-prod,A-prod}/requests.jsonl` and `bench/m1-notes.md`. All 5 config dirs have requests.jsonl, vram.txt, and 4 server logs with all 4 phases present.

**Done when 2** — Decision: do not deploy. Speculation is slower with both slots busy (prod: A dual-agent 26.7 vs off 31.3 tok/s; A dual-mem 23.4 vs off 25.4 tok/s; greedy: A dual-agent 25.5 vs off 26.3, B 23.0; A dual-mem 23.8 vs off 25.0) and changes temperature-0 outputs. Documented in `bench/m1-notes.md` §9d, `site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md`, `site/series/serving/index.md`, `site/index.md`. Live entry unchanged.

**Done when 3** — Experiment page `site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md`; series summary `site/series/serving/index.md` updated (Status + Deferred ideas); project summary `site/index.md` updated. Site checker passes: 10 pages, 0 errors.
